source_quote: The Registrar’s Office administers academic processes, enforces academic regulations,
answer: The Registrar's Office administers academic processes and regulations, maintains academic records, prepares course and exam schedules, assigns classrooms, registers students, issues transcripts, verifies graduation lists, and publishes the university calendar and catalog.

source_quote: Students and faculty have CampusVue personal secure accounts to
answer: Students have personal secure CampusVue accounts to access documents, courses, schedules, grades, and more.

source_quote: After consulting with their academic advisors, students must register for the courses they
answer: After consulting their academic advisors, students register during the registration period in the academic calendar. Advisors help complete Course Registration Forms and activate online CampusVue registration; forms are sent to the Registrar after drop/add.

source_quote: Any course registered online by the student without prior approval of the
answer: Any course a student registers online without prior approval of the academic advisor is automatically dropped.

source_quote: The course schedule must comply with the following rules: the prerequisite(s) of the
answer: A course schedule must meet these rules: prerequisites completed; courses required by the program and taken in study-plan order; failed courses taken when first offered; and minimum/maximum load rules met.
After registering, the student must print the statement of fees and pay all tuition and fees by the deadlines; failure to pay may result in classes being dropped from the schedule.

source_quote: The Lebanese Law mandates that all Lebanese students be registered with the NSSF.
answer: Lebanese law requires all Lebanese students to be registered with the NSSF (not required for non-Lebanese students). Admitted Lebanese students complete the Social Security Application form sent with the admission letter, indicating NSSF status, their or their parents' NSSF number, and an attestation of benefits.

answer: Expat students admitted to RHU must have passports valid for 13 months from the date of joining and must obtain a visa from the Lebanese Embassy in their country of origin.
